title: Provider-neutral Forge seam with a GitHub adapter
summary: Introduces a provider-neutral `Forge` trait (branch, pull request, status block, review, check status, head commit, capabilities) plus a pure `report_change` step that runs those calls in one fixed order, an in-memory `FakeForge` double, and a `GitHub` adapter that drives the existing `gh` command line. The `osf` CLI's review-post, status-apply and status-refresh paths are rewired to go through the trait, `pr_status` loses its process-spawning code and gains a `run` method on `GhClient`, and a new `osf forge pr open` subcommand opens a pull request through the adapter.

nodes.label: osf main
nodes.subtitle: clap dispatch
nodes.summary: Dispatches every subcommand. Now builds the GitHub adapter in one place (`github_adapter`) and routes review post, pr status apply/refresh and the new forge pr open through the Forge trait.

nodes.label: forge pr open
nodes.subtitle: osf forge pr open
nodes.summary: New subcommand: requires a builder token in GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN, resolves the repo from --repo or the origin remote, reads the body file, prepends the work item line, and calls Forge::open_pull_request.

nodes.label: review post
nodes.subtitle: osf review post
nodes.summary: Reads the head commit through the forge, builds the review plan, and posts through Forge::post_review, reporting a PostedReview or a ForgeError as output and exit code.

nodes.label: pr status apply
nodes.subtitle: osf pr status apply
nodes.summary: Dry run still reads the body through the client; a real apply now calls Forge::write_status_block with the block text.

nodes.label: pr status refresh
nodes.subtitle: osf pr status refresh
nodes.summary: Reads checks through Forge::read_check_status (or a checks JSON file), renders the block, and writes it through Forge::write_status_block.

nodes.label: Forge trait
nodes.subtitle: create_branch, open_pull_request, write_status_block, post_review, read_check_status, head_commit, capabilities
nodes.summary: The seam between the factory and a code host. Object-safe and Send + Sync; nothing in the module names a provider, URL or command.

nodes.label: Forge data types
nodes.subtitle: PullRequestId, NewReview, ReadOutcome, Capabilities
nodes.summary: Plain serializable request and result types, including ReadOutcome (Found/Empty/Unknown) and the capability report that distinguishes known verdicts from unknown ones.

nodes.label: report_change
nodes.subtitle: open → status block → capabilities → review → checks
nodes.summary: The Report step as provider-neutral run code: opens the pull request, writes the status block, reads capabilities, posts the review only when the identity may, then reads the check status, stopping at the first failed step with a ReportError naming it.

nodes.label: FakeForge
nodes.subtitle: in-memory double
nodes.summary: Records every call as plain data, can be told to fail an operation, and can script a sequence of answers per operation. Performs no process, file, network or clock work.

nodes.label: GitHub adapter
nodes.subtitle: GitHub<C: GhClient>
nodes.summary: The first Forge implementation: builds gh argv and JSON payloads for branch creation, pull request opening and review posting, reads checks and head commits, derives capabilities from the viewer and author logins, and falls back to an advisory comment on a self-review refusal.

nodes.label: RealGh
nodes.subtitle: GhClient over the gh binary
nodes.summary: Spawns the gh command line tool, writes stdin when given, and returns the raw GhOutput. Moved here from pr_status so the pure module holds no process-starting code.

nodes.label: pr_status
nodes.subtitle: pure status rendering
nodes.summary: Loses its RealGh implementation and Command import; gains GhOutput, a run method on GhClient, and a split of gates_from_checks_json into parse_checks plus gates_from_checks.

nodes.label: review
nodes.subtitle: plan, payload, fallback decisions
nodes.summary: Keeps the pure plan/payload/fallback logic and fetch_diff; drops fetch_head_sha and post_via_gh, and makes parse_head_sha_json public for the adapter.

nodes.subtitle: installed binary
nodes.summary: The installed gh tool the adapter shells out to for every host operation.

nodes.subtitle: repos, pulls, reviews, checks
nodes.summary: The remote endpoints behind gh: refs, pulls, reviews, checks and the viewer login.
